Create the file case_120.inp in the working directory using the exact input deck provided, preserving all whitespace and formatting.
Run CalculiX by executing ccx -i case_120; if that command is not recognized, fall back to ccx case_120.
After the run completes, check the file case_120.sta for a successful termination indicator such as the string "JOB COMPLETED".
If "JOB COMPLETED" is found, set the status to "success"; otherwise set the status to "error".
Determine the CalculiX version string by running ccx -v (or the closest equivalent, such as ccx --version) and record it in the ccx_version field.
Write a file named results.json in the working directory containing a JSON object with exactly the following keys: solver set to "calculix", case_id set to "case_120", status set to "success" or "error" based on the .sta check, ccx_version set to the version string obtained, artifacts set to an empty array, and notes set to a string.
In the notes field, record the exact ccx command that was used to run the analysis.
If the run failed, additionally include the error message and the name of the file that indicated the failure in the notes field.
Do not modify any values, node coordinates, element definitions, boundary conditions, material properties, or step definitions in the input deck.
